verdict.rationale: The only evidence is a vendor marketing claim that Lever is an 'All-in-One' platform replacing fragmented 'spreadsheets + email' workflows, plus mentions of built-in messaging and AI interview summaries that speed up feedback. Nothing shows these pieces landing in a single candidate record. Missing for 10: any documentation of a unified candidate profile, resume storage on the profile, email threads attached to the candidate, interview feedback within the record, activity history timeline, consent/GDPR status tracking, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
